full_judgment:
63. In view of the above situation and position we are to decide whether victim Biplob had the physical capability to make any statement before the witness. From exhibit-5 i.e. the post mortem report, it appears to us that victim Biplob sustained as many as 11 injuries on his person. The doctor himself opined that receiving such injuries the victim might have become unconscious. With the medical evidence if we consider the evidence of PWs- 6, 7, 11, 12 who deposed that they saw victim Biplob in unconscious condition, when they reached to the place of occurrence. We cannot brushed aside the inference of unconscious physical condition of victim Biplob. PW-1 and PW-2 in their depositions stated that when they reached to the place of occurrence they saw3 Kader, Zia (PW-12), Kazimuddin (PW-11), Mithu, Abdul and any others in the place of occurrence and in their presence victim made the alleged dying declaration PW-11 Kazimuddin. and PW-12 Zia alias Md Ziaur Rahman did not corroborate the testimony of PW-1 and PW-2 as to the making of dying declaration. More so Kader, Mithu and Abul were not examined by the prosecution, which creates an adverse presumption as to the veracity of making any dying declaration. More so, the prosecution failed to bring any evidence that what was the physical condition when victim Biplob was brought to Manikganj Hospital. 

 76. Non examination of vital witnesses namely Azizul, Kader, Bacchu and Mithu, Abul, (last two persons were present when victim Biplob made the alleged dying declaration) makes the prosecution case unreliable and the chain of circumstance leading to the killing of deceased Biplob by the condemned prisoners namely Lebu Miah, Masud, Swapan, Apple and Al-Amin has been broken. Moreso, it also creates an adverse presumption as to the veracity of the prosecution case in view of the provision of section 114(g) of the Evidence Act that had they been examined, they would not supported the prosecution story particularly the making of dying declaration by the deceased Biplob.
